translations.Open the link in the authenticator app: Open the link in the authenticator app
The login was declined on the phone.
The login was not confirmed in time.
New challenges are on the way.
translations.Enter your PIN or your OTP to start a ne: Enter your PIN or your OTP to start a new challenge.
translations.Check if service account has correct per: Check if service account has correct permissions
translations.Failed to fetch authentication token. Wr: Failed to fetch authentication token. Wrong HTTP return code: %s
translations.No token found for your user, Login is s: No token found for your user, Login is still enabled.
translations.Communication to the privacyIDEA server: Communication to the privacyIDEA server succeeded, but privacyIDEA does not know the user. This user logs in without a second factor, because "Let the user log in if the user is not found in privacyIDEA" is on. Check the realm.
Communication to the privacyIDEA server succeeded. The user was successfully authenticated.
Communication to the privacyIDEA server succeeded, but the user wasn't successfully authenticated.
Communication to the privacyIDEA server succeeded. However, the user failed to authenticate.
translations.The service account credentials are corr: The service account credentials are correct!
translations.But we recommend to update your privacyI: But we recommend to update your privacyIDEA server.
translations.In a second step of authentication, the: In a second step of authentication, the user is asked to provide a one time password. The users devices are managed in privacyIDEA. The authentication request is forwarded to privacyIDEA.
translations.Activate two factor authentication with: Activate two factor authentication with privacyIDEA
translations.Before activating two factor authenticat: Before activating two factor authentication with privacyIDEA, please assure, that the connection to your privacyIDEA-server is configured correctly.
translations.Please use the base URL of your privacyI: Please use the base URL of your privacyIDEA instance. For compatibility reasons, you may also specify the URL of the /validate/check endpoint.
translations.Sets timeout to privacyIDEA for login in: Sets timeout to privacyIDEA for login in seconds.
translations.If include is selected, just the groups: If include is selected, just the groups in this field need to do 2FA.
translations.If you select exclude, these groups can: If you select exclude, these groups can use 1FA (all others need 2FA).
You can either add single IPs like 10.0.1.12,10.0.1.13, a range like 10.0.1.12-10.0.1.113 or combinations like 10.0.1.12-10.0.1.113,192.168.0.15
translations.Select the user realm, if it is not the: Select the user realm, if it is not the default one.
translations.If you want to turn on the form-auto-sub: If you want to turn on the form-auto-submit function after x number of characters are entered into the OTP input field, set the expected OTP length here. Note: Only digits as the parameter's value allowed here.
translations.Do not uncheck this in productive enviro: Do not uncheck this in productive environments!
translations.Ignore the system wide proxy settings an: Ignore the system wide proxy settings and send authentication requests to privacyIDEA directly
translations.Check this to activate polling for a pus: Check this to activate polling for a push token confirmation right from your browser.
translations.The browser of the user sends the reques: The browser of the user sends the requests to this address. If it is not on the same origin as ownCloud, privacyIDEA must allow it with CORS headers. A reverse proxy that serves both under one origin also works.
translations.Test authentication by supplying usernam: Test authentication by supplying username and password that should be checked against privacyIDEA:
translations.Trigger challenges for challenge-respons: Trigger challenges for challenge-response tokens. Check this if you employ, e.g., SMS or E-Mail tokens.
translations.Let the user log in if the user is not f: Let the user log in if the user is not found in privacyIDEA.
translations.Show the passkey button on the login pag: Show the passkey button on the login page. The app asks privacyIDEA for a passkey challenge. Without this setting, the button is there only if privacyIDEA triggered a passkey challenge.
